name: Snowball
description: Alone, together, all of us — one question, distilled by everyone. The default question is class norms, which makes this a natural day-one or fresh-start activity; edit the question to snowball anything.

intro.message:
Three rounds: alone, together, all of us.

First you'll answer on your own — nobody can skip the thinking step. Then you and a partner will merge your answers into one. Then the whole class sees what the pairs built.

solo.prompt: What should our class norms be?

pairs.instruction: Combine your answers into one stronger answer.

end.message: Started as everyone's own idea. Ended as a few strong ones — built by all of us.
